MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 7
   C. 10
   D. 9

2. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 9

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

5. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 48

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 19

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 90

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

9. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

10. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
